scope: Strong fixed linear/RBF grids against time-aware class counts; selection by development NLL only. Not independent confirmation or architectural advantage. All tuning/Platt internal CV in measured fit wall; third-party solver FLOPs unavailable, not zero. Common raw preprocessing charged separately; no Transformer/LSTM training or official test. Admission requires >=5pp learning gain and >=5pp accuracy headroom.
